corrections.reason: Drawn as the water column of Axial Base: the shallow (RS03AXPS) and deep (RS03AXPD) profiler moorings stand about 1.5 km from the seafloor package (RS03AXBS), and the map shows them as that site's column.

Drawn as the water column of Oregon Slope Base: the shallow (RS01SBPS) and deep (RS01SBPD) profiler moorings stand about 1.5-2 km from the seafloor package (RS01SLBS), and the map shows them as that site's column.
